summary: Lixiang Education filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share. The notification from Nasdaq on May 21, 2026 confirmed that the closing bid price of its ADSs had been at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from May 7 to May 20, 2026. The company had previously received a deficiency notice on November 18, 2025 and effected a 1-for-10 reverse stock split on April 20, 2026 to address the issue. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation.
